description: State-of-the-art rules for writing and auditing asynchronous and concurrent code across runtimes (Python asyncio, JS/Node, Go, Rust, JVM). Use when building anything with async/await, threads, processes, event loops, task groups, channels, or queues — and when auditing existing code for race conditions, deadlocks, leaked tasks, blocked event loops, missing cancellation, or backpressure failures. Not for latency/throughput profiling and optimization — use sota-performance. Trigger keywords: async, await, concurrency, parallelism, threads, race condition, deadlock, event loop, channels, queues, semaphore, mutex, cancellation, timeout, backpressure, task group, goroutine, tokio, asyncio.
